page.overview:
Who is Kevin Straker?

The head of Kevin Straker is based on [https://terminator.fandom.com/wiki/Model_101 T-800: Model 101] from [https://terminator.fandom.com/wiki/The_Terminator_(film) The Terminator] (1984), and his cyborg-cop armor is based on the OCP robotic-police armor of [https://robocop.fandom.com/wiki/RoboCop Officer Alex J. Murphy] from [https://robocop.fandom.com/wiki/RoboCop_(1987) RoboCop] (1987). Both ultraviolent cyberpunk action-crime thriller films were by Orion Pictures.

In the American localized version, Kevin Straker is instead identified as Ken Masters from Street Fighter (1987). To tie him into the hero of this game due to his blonde hair, extraordinary agility, as well the game's title with the year 2010 added.

In the game's story, Kevin is a cyborg cop in the year 2010 AD in service of the Galaxy Police (Heavy Crimes division), codenamed Valentine Type MX-5 (MX-5 for short). Armed with an energy bullet, his mission is to eradicate out-of-control parasites and their mutated hosts, gather their power to open a portal, and proceed through to the next world.

On the human side of Kevin, he feels pain every time he gets hurt and that "something is crawling around inside of him", he finds out ultimately that he is one of the parasites himself. Dr. Jose, who was one of the researchers behind the parasites, had created Kevin in order to use him as a weapon to control the universe, leading him along this path to gain more and more power. Refusing to be used in such a manner, he fights against the doctor, and then is left to ponder his fate.
